scripts.dev:server: BABYLOG_WORK_DIR="$PWD" sh -c 'cd backend && exec go run github.com/air-verse/air@v1.67.4 -c .air.toml'
scripts.admin:init: BABYLOG_WORK_DIR="$PWD" sh -c 'cd backend && exec go run ./cmd/babylog admin init "$@"' --
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:web && pnpm lint:guardrails && pnpm lint:go
scripts.lint:guardrails: sh -c 'set -e; for f in scripts/*.sh; do sh -n "$f"; done; if grep -rnE "text-\\[([0-9]|1[01])px\\]" src/; then echo "Found font size below 12px in src/" >&2; exit 1; fi; q=$(printf "\047"); if grep -rnE --exclude-dir=ui "type=[${q}\"]checkbox[${q}\"]" src/; then echo "Use Checkbox from @/components/ui/checkbox instead of raw input[type=checkbox]" >&2; exit 1; fi; if command -v openspec >/dev/null 2>&1; then openspec validate --specs --strict; fi'
scripts.lint:go: cd backend && sh -c 'out=$(gofmt -l .); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "Unformatted Go files:"; echo "$out"; exit 1; fi' && CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./... && CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet -tags embedwebui ./...
scripts.build:server: sh -c 'set -e; test -f dist/index.html || { echo "请先运行 pnpm build:web 构建前端产物" >&2; exit 1; }; trap "find backend/internal/webui/dist -mindepth 1 ! -name .gitkeep -delete" EXIT; mkdir -p backend/internal/webui/dist bin; find backend/internal/webui/dist -mindepth 1 ! -name .gitkeep -delete; cp -R dist/. backend/internal/webui/dist/; VER="${BABYLOG_VERSION:-dev}"; COMMIT="${BABYLOG_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)}"; BUILD_DATE="${BABYLOG_BUILD_DATE:-$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)}"; (cd backend && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags embedwebui -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=${VER} -X main.commit=${COMMIT} -X main.buildDate=${BUILD_DATE}" -o ../bin/babylog ./cmd/babylog)'
